summary: A Bondi Junction firm with almost three decades of experience is a strength, but a dead Free Consultation button and a 2023 footer appear to cost you enquiries.

findings.problem: The Free Consultation button appears three times and links to #, and Terms and Conditions, Privacy Policy, Get a Call Back and the search icon appear to link to # as well.
findings.cost: A client ready to enquire hits a dead button.

findings.problem: The footer appears to read 2023, the header appears to read JassyLawyer while the logo says Jassy Lawyers, and a staging address appears in the page code.
findings.cost: An old date and mixed names make a firm look inactive.
findings.fix: A current footer and one consistent name.

findings.problem: The time dropdown appears to show options run together (8 AM9 AM10 AM), the phone number appears with no area code, and the phone link appears to contain a space.
findings.cost: Broken form details and a phone link that may not dial lose enquiries.
findings.fix: A clean form and a correct click to call link.

findings.problem: No lawyers, testimonials or case results appear, only statements such as 'proven experts' and 'decades of experience'.
findings.cost: Clients choosing a lawyer need proof of who they are hiring.
findings.fix: Named lawyers, credentials and client feedback.

redesign: A current footer and one name.
A clean form, named lawyers and visible proof.
